title: coding-comms: cover answers to questions; add rules for the passive, markup and revisions
head: coding-comms-answers
body:
Adds answers to questions to the skill's scope, with a template: the answer first, in the asker's words, at about the question's length.

Adds three rules:
- Step 2: use the passive when it puts the thing the reader asked about first.
- Step 4: use only the markup that the destination renders.
- Step 5: show the whole text again after each revision.

Tested: not tested on clean agents.
